column1: # Per-file real macOS bats wall time (seconds), used by shard-tests.sh to
# weight the CI partition by measured cost instead of @test count (#1243).
# @test count is a loose, occasionally blind proxy for a file's real cost:
# a file whose time is almost entirely waiting (background processes, poll
# loops) can carry a tiny count while dominating its shard's wall clock, and
# a file that is merely large in @test count is not necessarily slow. This
# table sidesteps the proxy by using each file's own measured time directly.
# MEASURED AGAINST: GitHub Actions runs 41483878932 (attempts 1 and 2),
# (file_end rows with status 0, macOS only). Each row is the HIGHEST value
# any of those runs recorded for the file, so a shard's planned total is a
# slow-runner total rather than a typical one. All 154 test files are present.
# run that already had the mock servers' reverse-DNS fix (#1867): before it
# they took 606 s and 216 s, after it 9 s and 5 s.
# WHY THIS REFRESH: the previous table was measured on 2026-09-29 and had
# drifted far enough to stack work on one shard. test_install.bats was
# weighted 158 s but now takes 491-550 s, test_spawn.bats 402 -> 531 s, and 26
# files added since (test_agmsgd_daemon_sh.bats alone 248 s) had no row at all
# and were estimated at the average. macOS shards were reaching the
# 30-minute cap while still passing tests (runs 41486605221 and
# A file with no row here (renamed, or added after this measurement) is
# estimated at this table's own average seconds/file by shard-tests.sh,
# never treated as zero-cost or dropped from the partition -- coverage does
# not depend on this table being current. tests/test_ci_sharding.bats's
# balance-ratio assertion checks the computed partition against THIS
# table's own numbers, not against a live run, so it cannot detect this
# table drifting out of sync with reality -- only a human noticing a real
# run's shard skew (as happened here) triggers a refresh. Refresh by
# re-running this extraction against a green run's bats-timings artifacts.
# Columns: basename<TAB>seconds. Sorted by basename for a legible diff.
